name: libp2p_mix_rln_module
description: Standalone Logos mix intermediate node: libp2p transport, Sphinx-based mix routing, RLN per-hop rate limiting. Targets LIP LOGOS-MIXNET; see README for interoperability and deployment requirements.
author: Logos Core Team

config.description: JSON config — inline, or a path to a JSON file — overlaid onto the default options when the module is loaded. RLN protection requires a registryId and a started shared RLN backend. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET fixes several protocol parameters (path length, Sphinx sizes, cover-traffic strategy); those are not configurable. Parameters marked TBD in LIP LOGOS-MIXNET are exposed here with placeholder defaults that MUST be pinned before mainnet use.

schema.addrs: array<multiaddr string> — IPv4 libp2p listen addresses
schema.privKey: string — hex-encoded libp2p host private key. Omit to generate on start.
schema.maxConnsPerPeer: int — default 2, allowing simultaneous inbound/outbound dials

mix.mixPrivKey: string — hex-encoded X25519 private key advertised for Sphinx path selection. Omit to generate on start.

cover.rateFraction: float — CONSTANT_RATE cover-traffic ratio. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET default: 0.7.

rln.registryId: string — shared RLN registry scope, required
rln.rlnIdentifierHex: string — 32-byte application identifier shared by every Mix participant
rln.epochDurationSeconds: int — RLN epoch length. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET default 10.
rln.maxEpochGap: int — accepted epoch drift. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET default 3.
rln.userMessageLimit: int — per-user message cap per epoch. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET default 100.
rln.proofMetadataContentTopic: string — RLN Relay content topic for proof metadata. LIP LOGOS-MIXNET: TBD; placeholder "/mix/rln/metadata/v1".
